descriptionNullable:
This dataset is a comprehensive multi-year collection of hourly air quality measurements across major cities in the Delhi National Capital Region (Delhi, Gurgaon, Noida, Faridabad, Ghaziabad). The dataset spans from January 2019 through 2024, capturing detailed pollutant concentrations, computed AQI values, and temporal metadata for each observation.

Each record includes geolocation coordinates, pollutant levels (CO, NO₂, O₃, PM10, PM2.5, SO₂), AQI category, and pre-engineered time features (hour, weekday, month, weekend flag), making the dataset ready for:

Air quality forecasting (ARIMA, LSTM, hybrid DL models)

Pollution pattern analysis (seasonal, diurnal, yearly trends)

Spatial risk assessment & hotspot detection

Predictive modelling with pollutant regressors

Health exposure and epidemiological research

ML feature engineering and anomaly detection

The multi-year span allows for long-term trend analysis, pre/post COVID impact comparisons, winter smog pattern analysis, and climate-related changes.
